description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of the 'git diff-tree' command with '--max-depth' options and pathspecs. It includes functions for setting up test directories and files, performing various test cases to verify correct handling of maximum depth in different git object comparisons, and checks for expected success or failure outcomes.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory and writes a provided message to a file inside it.

methods.name: make_files
methods.description: Creates a file with specific content and builds a directory structure.

methods.name: check_one
methods.description: Performs a test comparing expected and actual output of 'git diff-tree' with specific depth and pathspec.

methods.name: check_trees
methods.description: Runs a series of depth comparison tests on trees for various boundary conditions.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Runs tests for index comparisons with depth limitations.
